items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I got to working with Dud Bascomb’s band, the trumpet player with Erskine Hawkins. He got a band, and we started working out in New Jersey...

ctx.x: What other bands came through Greensboro?

Oh, man, all of them came through there. Jay McShann. Andy Kirk. Erskine Hawkins. Lionel Hampton, of course. Illinois Jacquet, of course. Illinois Jacquet, of course. Louis Jordan. Several other bands—I can’t think of all of them.
So this was all during that year or two after you were discharged from the Navy.
